Inbound SMB self-serve lead. Signed up for free credits via hosted API trial (signup 2026-02-20). Early discovery call 2026-03-03 with CEO (Ari Patel) + Head of Product (Samira Khan). Primary ask: lightweight knowledge base assistant for customers + internal docs search + automated summarization of long support threads.

Key points from call (shorthand):
- "Needs low-latency search/summarization for < 500ms typical response, mostly short prompts but occasional long-context summaries (~2-3k tokens)."
- "Model Qs: 'Should we start on a smaller Llama/Qwen to keep cost down or use Mistral XL for better TL;DR quality?'"
- "Wants concrete token cost examples: 100k queries/month, avg 150 tokens out, 50 tokens in. Cost-sensitive."
- "Prefers public cloud, likely AWS region us-west-2. No immediate on-prem requirement. SSO/SAML integration required for admin console. SOC2 compliance expected for vendor. Audit logs & retention controls matter, but data residency not required today."
- "Asked about streaming + function calling for multi-step workflows (ticket creation from summary)."

What we recommended on call (AE/SE notes):
- Start on hosted_api self-serve using a smaller cost-optimized variant (qwen-7b or llama-2-13b quantized) for search + short responses to validate UX.
- For high-quality summarization POC (long context), try mistral-xl-instruct or a 13-16B Llama variant in a canary route to compare quality on the same prompts.
- Use Redwood Optimize suggestions: prefix caching for KB hits + batching for peak times to keep per-token costs down.
- Provide sample cost calc: estimate ~ $2k-$6k/mo on hosted depending on model mix (mix strategy: 80% cheap model, 20% high-quality summarization model).

Quotes: "We want something that doesn't break the bank but actually summarizes like a human — that's the tough tradeoff." — Ari P.

Internal notes: good fit for PLG-hosted funnel. Low friction to convert if they like cost/quality numbers. Upsell path: Dedicated if throughput grows > 5M tokens/mo or if they need stricter VPC isolation. SE to prepare side-by-side sample outputs (same prompt) for Qwen/Llama/Mistral and a spreadsheet with token-cost scenarios.

Potential risks: if initial cheap-model outputs are poor they'll bail early. Need quick wins (search relevance metrics + one-click integration with their SSO).
